# Mutakamel Tenant Portal

Standalone Next.js tenant application. Arabic-first, RTL by default, fixed
port 5002. One of three portals in the `frontend` pnpm workspace
(admin 5001, tenant 5002, partner 5003).

Documentation rebuilt: 2026-08-27.

## Read first

- AGENTS.md
- docs/README.md
- docs/CONTRACT.md
- docs/architecture/file-architecture.md
- docs/design/README.md
- docs/design/anti-patterns.md
- docs/api/README.md

If you are executing the rebuild: docs/build/HANDOFF.md

## Browser API namespaces

- Core: /api/tenant/core/v1/*
- CRM: /api/tenant/crm/v1/*
- Trade: /api/tenant/trade/v1/*
- Worker: no direct tenant-browser API

API Gateway is the only browser backend edge. Never call owning services
directly. Never modify ../backend from this project.

## Source precedence

1. Gateway typed route contracts
2. Owning controller and global/module guards
3. DTOs, enums, service/response contracts, entities, tests
4. Installed @mutakamel/* package declarations
5. Current tenant-portal source and tests
6. This documentation
7. Mocks and comments, which are never contracts

## Current state

573 Gateway tenant routes (core 199, CRM 143, Trade 231).

Live in the portal: login and session management, CRM leads, customer
profiles, opportunities/pipelines, and four CRM catalogues. Trade has no
portal screen. 45 route scaffolds are sealed behind an unavailable boundary
and are scheduled for deletion.

The transport and session layer (src/lib/api, src/lib/auth,
src/lib/notifications, src/shared/tenancy, src/context) is production-grade
and tested. Do not rewrite it.

There is no design system yet — docs/design/ specifies one, and
docs/build/ sequences building it.

## Generated evidence

- docs/generated/tenant-api-routes.json — scripts/docs/generate-route-inventory.mjs
- docs/api/core-reference.md, crm-reference.md, trade-reference.md —
  scripts/docs/generate-api-reference.mjs

Never hand-edit generated files.

## Verification

From tenant-portal:

- pnpm verify        (typecheck + lint + test + docs:check + design:rtl)
- pnpm build
- pnpm design:census -- --check

Do not report a capability live until it exists in tenant-portal, uses the
server-backed contract, works in both languages and both themes, and has
proportional tests.
